2607.14984.title: Demographically-Conditioned Synthetic Medical Images for Bias Mitigation and Bias Detection in Disease Classifiers
2607.14984.paper_summary: Per-subgroup fairness audits of medical image classifiers face a sample-size problem: minority subgroups in held-out test sets have so few samples that the resulting confidence intervals on per-subgroup performance are wider than the bias the audit is meant to detect. We argue that a demographically-conditioned synthetic generator can do both: mitigate bias on the training side and detect bias on the evaluation side. Working on COVID-19 chest CT classification with an end-to-end fine-tuned Stable Diffusion 2.1 generator, we make two findings. For bias mitigation (training), a demographically-balanced synthetic cohort is most useful as a pretraining prior, not as joint augmentation: with the same fixed data, sequential pretraining followed by fine-tuning substantially outperforms joint augmentation, and the resulting classifier surpasses the full-real baseline at $\sim$$100\times$ real-data efficiency. For bias detection (evaluation), across five synthetic minority cohorts and five classifier seeds, the synthetic estimator reproduces the subgroup ranking of a well-powered real oracle (Spearman $ρ= 1.00$ on MCC and Recall) and gives the more reliable per-cell estimate where the small real test set runs out of samples. The synthetic cohort is therefore most useful in exactly the cells that fairness audits care about, as both a fix for and a measure of subgroup bias.
2607.14984.paper_summary_zh: 醫學影像分類器的每個子群公平性審計面臨樣本大小問題：在保留的測試集中，少數子群的樣本數量極少，以至於每個子群性能的置信區間比審計旨在檢測的偏差還要寬。我們主張，一個基於人口統計的合成生成器可以同時做到這兩點：減輕訓練階段的偏差並檢測評估階段的偏差。在針對 COVID-19 胸部 CT 分類的工作中，使用端到端微調的 Stable Diffusion 2.1 生成器，我們得出了兩個發現。對於偏差減輕（訓練），人口統計平衡的合成隊列作為預訓練先驗最為有用，而不是作為聯合增強：在相同的固定數據下，順序預訓練再加上微調的效果顯著優於聯合增強，並且所得到的分類器在約 $100\times$ 實際數據效率上超越了全真實基線。對於偏差檢測（評估），在五個合成少數群體和五個分類器種子中，合成估計器再現了一個具有良好功效的真實預言者的子群排名（在 MCC 和召回率上 Spearman $ρ= 1.00$），並在小型真實測試集樣本耗盡的情況下提供了更可靠的每個細胞估計。因此，合成隊列在公平性審計關心的細胞中最為有用，既是解決子群偏差的修正，也是測量子群偏差的工具。
